implication: For the current contract which derives applicability from these separate facts, removing follow-up-only and simple monitoring questions does not prove an ordinary path <=15. This is not a proof about every possible source-bound contract. Do not reclassify ordinary initiation as complex merely due to this count or weaken the canonical criterion.
alternative_needing_review: The source assigns benefit/risk assessment to the clinician. A precisely scoped, independently supplied clinician hepatic benefit/risk decision could potentially replace calculation of that decision from risk factors. It must not be a universal all-clear box, must not assert unknown factors absent, must not waive absolute exclusions, and must not conceal raw operands required by the selected result. Its count and remaining dementia/reproductive conditions require separate reconstruction.
